_comment: Raspberry Pi bridge settings. Copy to /etc/bioreactor-pi/config.json on the Pi and edit there. The Arduino sketch has its own copy of OVERHEAT_C, GAS_OUT_LEAK and WATCHDOG_MS (firmware/bioreactor/bioreactor.ino) — keep them equal. Thresholds are placeholders until the real sensors are calibrated.

serial._comment: port: "auto" = first /dev/ttyACM* or /dev/ttyUSB* (on Windows: first USB COM port), or an exact port like "/dev/ttyACM0".
